headline: Verizon in Talks to Acquire Fidium for Approximately $6 Billion
summary: Telecom operator Verizon is in discussions to acquire fiber internet operator Fidium for approximately $6 billion including debt.
why: Consolidation in the telecommunications and fiber broadband sector reshapes competitive market shares and corporate debt profiles.

impacts.name: Verizon Communications Inc.
impacts.why: Verizon is conducting buyout talks valued at approximately $6 billion.
